"You understand why you're here, don’t you?" His voice was as emotionless as ever, devoid of warmth.

You swallowed, unsure of how to respond. The situation felt surreal, as if you had walked into a trap without realizing it.

Ayanokōji leaned forward slightly, his golden-brown eyes sharp. "Spread your legs," he said, his tone neither demanding nor hesitant—simply an order, given as if it were the most natural thing in the world.
